message:
go.mod: add pgregory.net/rapid v1.2.0 for property-based testing

Add rapid as a test dependency for writing property-based tests
across the headscale codebase.

types: add property-based tests for Node, TailNode, AuthID, and Users

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

- EndpointsChanged: reflexivity, commutativity, order-independence,
  nil/empty equivalence
- Node.Prefixes, SubnetRoutes, ExitRoutes: host prefix correctness,
  intersection with approved routes, exit route filtering
- IsTagged/IsUserOwned: XOR invariant including tagged nodes with UserID
- TailscaleUserID: tagged vs user-owned dispatch, orphaned node behavior
- Owner().Name(): nil pointer dereference on orphaned nodes
- TailNode conversion: ID preservation, AllowedIPs composition,
  MachineAuthorized/Expired complement, tags-as-identity
- HasNetworkChanges/HasPolicyChange: reflexivity
- GetFQDN: empty GivenName, baseDomain suffix, length bounds
- PeerChangeFromMapRequest + ApplyPeerChange: roundtrip correctness
- FilterByIP: subset, completeness, no false negatives
- AuthID: generation validity, prefix/length rejection
- CleanIdentifier: idempotency, no double slashes
- OIDC Identifier: path traversal bug with Sub='..'
- ValidateUsername: acceptance, rejection, at-sign rules

Known failing tests that document real bugs:
- TestRapid_TailscaleUserID_OrphanedNodePanic: silent UserID(0)
  for invalid state (Tags=nil, UserID=nil)
- TestRapid_OwnerName_NilUserNilTagsPanic: nil pointer dereference
  through Owner().Name() on orphaned nodes
- TestRapid_OIDCClaims_Identifier_PathTraversalSubLost: url.JoinPath
  treats Sub='..' as path traversal, dropping the subject

types/change: add property-based tests for Change merge and filtering

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

- Merge boolean fields: commutativity, associativity, idempotence,
  identity element
- Merge peer sets: commutativity, union correctness
- IsEmpty/IsFull monotonicity under merge
- FullUpdate absorption
- Type() classification soundness
- uniqueNodeIDs: idempotency, sorted output, no duplicates,
  value preservation
- Constructor correctness: FullUpdate, SelfUpdate, NodeAdded
- FilterForNode: targeted changes dropped for other nodes
- SplitTargetedAndBroadcast: partition completeness
- ShouldSendToNode: consistency with FilterForNode
- Merge-then-Filter vs Filter-then-Merge equivalence

Known failing tests that document real bugs:
- TestRapid_Merge_MutationSafety: append on PeersChanged/PeersRemoved
  writes through shared backing array when receiver has spare capacity
- TestRapid_Merge_AliasingWithSpareCapacity: same bug, explicit
  spare capacity trigger
- TestRapid_Merge_PeerPatchesAliasing: same pattern on PeerPatches
- TestRapid_Merge_ThenFilter_EquivalentTo_FilterThenMerge: merging
  changes with different TargetNode values silently drops the second
  target's data into the first target's change

policy/v2: add property-based tests for policy engine and filter rules

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

Policy engine:
- BuildPeerMap symmetry, self-exclusion, no duplicates
- Empty and wildcard policies produce correct full-mesh
- mergeFilterRules semantic equivalence and idempotence
- ReduceFilterRules subset property with targeted generators
- Policy JSON roundtrip fidelity
- Overlapping ACLs: no false negatives from rule ordering
- Tag-based ACL symmetry and isolation
- autogroup:member/tagged partition correctness
- Restrictive user-scoped policy isolation
- Transitive tag ownership resolution
- autogroup:self port scoping
- SetNodes incremental peer map updates
- Port-specific rule compilation correctness
- FilterForNode tagged vs untagged differentiation

Parsing utilities:
- splitDestinationAndPort: roundtrip, IPv6 brackets, error cases
- parsePortRange: wildcard, single port, range, comma-separated
- parsePort: roundtrip, negative/overflow rejection

policy/matcher: add property-based tests for ACL matching

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

- MatchFromStrings wildcard: '*' source matches any IP
- MatchFromStrings CIDR containment: member IPs are matched
- MatchFromStrings empty source: matches nothing

mapper: add property-based tests for batcher and MapResponse builder

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

Batcher:
- computePeerDiff: set difference correctness
- updateSentPeers + computePeerDiff roundtrip
- addToBatch: FullUpdate override, targeted vs broadcast splitting,
  PeersRemoved cleanup, FilterForNode self-origin handling
- processBatchedChanges: drain correctness
- multiChannelNodeConn.send: fan-out to all active connections
- Concurrent send and close safety

MapResponse builder:
- KeepAlive always false, ControlTime always set
- WithPeersRemoved correctness and overwrite behavior
- WithPeerChangedPatch passthrough
- Build determinism

Adversarial mapper tests:
- generateMapResponse routing: SelfOnly guard, self-update path,
  empty change nil return, RuntimePeerComputation priority
- buildFromChange: PeersChanged+PeersRemoved composition,
  self-update field dropping
- policyChangeResponse: removed peer ID conversion precision
- PeerPatches always included regardless of SendAllPeers

routes: add property-based state machine test for PrimaryRoutes

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

- Stateful state machine test with oracle model: SetRoutes,
  RemoveNode, QueryPrimary operations with invariant checks
  after every operation
- Failover chain: sequential removal with correct primary election
- Overlapping prefixes: independent tracking of /16, /20, /24
- Rapid flap: 20-50 random add/remove operations with consistency
- Bulk operations: atomic failover of 10-20 prefixes
- Changed return value: oracle comparison for SetRoutes bool result

Invariants verified: exactly one primary per prefix, primary is
valid advertiser, no orphaned primaries, stability of existing
primaries, deterministic lowest-ID selection for new primaries.

state: add property-based tests for NodeStore and tag validation

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

NodeStore snapshots:
- allNodes count, nodesByID completeness
- nodesByNodeKey/nodesByMachineKey consistency
- nodesByUser excludes tagged nodes, includes user-owned
- peersByNode self-exclusion and symmetry
- Empty input produces empty snapshot

Live NodeStore operations:
- UpdateNode callback sees latest state from prior updates
- ListPeers consistent with GetNodeByID
- Policy change + RebuildPeerMaps correctly updates visibility
- NodeKey rotation: old key not found, new key resolves
- DeleteNode: full cleanup across all indexes

Tag validation:
- validateAndNormalizeTags: format, prefix, dedup, sorting
- validateRequestTags: non-tagged node rejection

Known failing test that documents a real bug:
- TestRapid_RoutesChanged_MutationSafety: routesChanged() at
  state.go:2497 sorts newHI.RoutableIPs in-place via aliased
  slice header, mutating the caller's Hostinfo

db: add property-based tests for IP allocation, names, and preauth keys

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

IP allocation:
- Next() uniqueness within prefix, prefix containment
- Reserved IP exclusion
- Sequential and random strategy correctness
- Small prefix exhaustion behavior

Name generation:
- generateGivenName: length bounds, DNS safety, suffix handling
- Migration tag merge slice aliasing

PreAuth keys:
- Validate: nil, expired, used non-reusable, valid keys
- isValidBase64URLSafe: character class property

Known failing test that documents a real bug:
- TestRapid_MigrationTagMerge_SliceAliasingBug: migration code at
  db.go:680 uses append(existingTags, validatedTags...) which
  aliases node.Tags backing array when spare capacity exists

util: add property-based tests for DNS and address parsing

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

DNS validation:
- ValidateHostname: accepts valid, rejects short/long/uppercase
- NormaliseHostname: idempotency, output validity, lowercase,
  length bounds, valid input preservation
- ValidateUsername: acceptance, short rejection, non-letter start,
  multiple at-sign rejection
- GenerateIPv4DNSRootDomain: all FQDNs end with .in-addr.arpa.,
  deterministic count from prefix bits, no duplicates

Address parsing:
- ParseIPSet wildcard: contains any IP
- ParseIPSet CIDR: contains member IPs, excludes outsiders
- ParseIPSet single IP: contains exactly that IP

servertest: add property-based full-stack and cross-component tests

Add rapid property-based tests covering:

Stateful mesh operations:
- TestRapidMeshOperations: AddClient, Disconnect, Reconnect with
  symmetric visibility, unique IPs, unique NodeIDs invariants
- TestRapidMeshChurn: high-frequency connect/disconnect cycles
- TestRapidPolicyToggle: allow-all to restrictive policy transitions

Full-stack cross-component test:
- TestRapidFullStackOperations: 8 operations (AddClient for two
  users, DeleteNode, SetRestrictivePolicy, SetAllowAllPolicy,
  AdvertiseRoute, DisconnectClient, ReconnectClient) with 9
  invariants (netmap presence, symmetric visibility, unique IDs,
  unique IPs, DERP map, server node count, deleted node absence,
  allow-all peer count, restrictive policy isolation)

Focused cross-component tests:
- TestRapid_PolicyToggle_PeerCountConverges: rapid policy toggling
  with multi-user visibility verification
- TestRapid_DisconnectReconnect_PeerVisibilityRestored: disconnect/
  reconnect cycles with peer count recovery
- TestRapid_RouteAdvertisement_PeersGetAllowedIPs: route advertise,
  approve, and AllowedIPs propagation to all peers
- TestRapid_PolicyChangeWithRoutes_AllowedIPsConsistent: policy
  change with active approved routes

Known failing tests that document real bugs:
- TestRapidFullStackOperations: asymmetric peer visibility after
  complex sequences of DeleteNode + SetRestrictivePolicy +
  ReconnectClient
- TestRapid_PolicyChangeWithRoutes_AllowedIPsConsistent: approved
  subnet routes are stripped from AllowedIPs when switching from
  allow-all to restrictive policy, breaking subnet routing for
  peers that remain visible

all: improve property test generators for deeper bug finding

Make generators more adversarial to find bugs that simple inputs miss:

Policy filter rules: vary CIDR prefix lengths [24,32] instead of
always /32. Add generator with shared SrcIPs to exercise the
mergeFilterRules DstPorts-combining path.

Types: allow genSubnetPrefix to produce /0 bits so .Masked() can
create exit routes. Fix test models to filter exit routes from
expected values (SubnetRoutes and TailNode PrimaryRoutes correctly
exclude exit routes).

NodeStore: share MachineKeys across nodes with 30% probability.
Allow nil IPv4/IPv6. Scale node count to 100+. This found a real
bug: nodesByMachineKey index collision when tagged nodes share a
MachineKey (all tagged nodes have the same TypedUserID).

Batcher: add adversarial change generator with conflicting flags
(SendAllPeers+TargetNode, PeersChanged/PeersRemoved overlap,
self-referencing OriginNode==TargetNode, all-flags-true). Use high
NodeIDs for PeersRemoved to avoid triggering batcher node cleanup.

Routes: widen NodeID range to [1,5000] and node count to [3,50]
for failover chain tests. Add arbitrary prefix generation.

Known failing test that documents a new real bug:
- TestRapid_Snapshot_NodesByMachineKeyConsistency: when two tagged
  nodes share a MachineKey, they collide in nodesByMachineKey
  because all tagged nodes have the same TypedUserID constant

state: fix NodeStore test to enforce MachineKey uniqueness

MachineKeys are unique per node, enforced at registration time. The
generator was artificially sharing MachineKeys across nodes, which
tested an impossible scenario and produced a false positive.

Remove the shared MachineKey generator. Update the test to verify
the uniqueness invariant: no two nodes in the snapshot share the
same MachineKey.

all: fix golangci-lint issues in property-based tests

Address all lint findings from golangci-lint --new-from-rev:

- err113: use static errors with fmt.Errorf wrapping
- errorlint: use errors.As instead of type assertions
- exhaustive: add missing switch cases
- forbidigo: nolint for intentional time.Sleep in PBT
- goconst: extract repeated string literals to constants
- gocritic: collapse else-if, use cmp.Compare, simplify branches
- gosec: nolint for bounded integer conversions in test code
- intrange/modernize: use range-over-int, slices/maps helpers
- noinlineerr: split inline error handling
- prealloc: preallocate slices with known capacity
- staticcheck: nolint for intentional empty branches
- unused: remove unused functions and types
- wsl: add required blank lines
